source: FDD Long War Journal, Peshmerga Ministry, Rudaw Media Network, AFP, Shafaq News
note: Iraq is both a target of Iranian/militia drone and missile attacks (primarily against US and diplomatic facilities) and a staging ground for Iran-backed militia attacks on GCC states. Iraqi air defenses did not publish official cumulative totals; entries reflect verified open-source reporting. Figures marked null could not be independently confirmed from official statements.

daily.label: 28 Feb
daily.events: Operation Epic Fury begins. Islamic Resistance in Iraq (IRI) claimed 16 drone attacks against enemy bases in Iraq and the region. At least two Iraqi security bases struck: Basrah Operations Command and Imam Ali base in Dhi Qar. Drones/missiles intercepted near Erbil International Airport (US forces present). Saraya Awliya al Dam (SAD) claimed attack on US military at Erbil Airport with 'squadron of drones'. Unclaimed airstrike (likely US/Israel) on Jurf al-Nasr area, Babil: 2 PMF members killed, 3 injured — PMF said target was a Kataib Hezbollah site (PMF statement via Shafaq News).
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, PMF statement

daily.label: 1 Mar
daily.events: SAD claimed attack on US bases in Erbil with drones and missiles; Rudaw confirmed explosions at Erbil International Airport. IRI claimed 21 operations using dozens of drones. Asaib Ahl al Haq announced 4 members killed in unclaimed airstrike, calling it a joint US-Israeli operation (Asaib Ahl al Haq statement).
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, Rudaw Media Network

daily.label: 2 Mar
daily.events: SAD claimed attack on Camp Victoria at Baghdad International Airport with 'squadron of drones'. Arabic-language media reported explosions near the base with air defenses activated against 2 drones. IRI claimed 28 additional operations using dozens of missiles and drones against bases in Iraq and region.

daily.label: 3 Mar
daily.events: SAD claimed drone attack on hotel in Erbil allegedly housing US soldiers (unconfirmed claim). IRI claimed 27 more missile and drone attacks targeting sites in Iraq and beyond.

daily.label: 4 Mar
daily.events: SAD claimed attack on hotel in Erbil and 2 drone attacks on US presence at Erbil International Airport. Multiple drones targeted Victoria Base at Baghdad International Airport. Unclaimed airstrike killed Abu Hassan al Fariji (Kataib Hezbollah commander) and another militia member in Babil. Four strikes hit PMF facilities in Nineveh (Kataib Sayyid al Shuhada and PMF 30th Brigade; no casualties). Iraqi Security Media Cell confirmed airstrike on Iraqi security forces near Karbala: 1 soldier killed, 2 injured. Kuwait summoned Iraqi Chargé d'Affaires to protest Iraq-based militia targeting of Kuwait.
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, Iraqi Security Media Cell (SMC) via X

daily.label: 5 Mar
daily.events: IRI claimed 29 operations using dozens of drones and missiles in the preceding 24 hours. Attack of unspecified nature on Azadi Camp hosting Iranian-Kurdish opposition groups — no casualties. Early morning: explosive-laden Iranian remotely controlled boat targeted and damaged an oil tanker near Iraq's Khor al Zubair port, Basra (Iran International). IRI claimed it downed a US MQ-9 drone; US said aircraft was not lost to hostile fire (CENTCOM).
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, Iran International, CENTCOM

daily.label: 9 Mar
daily.events: Air defenses intercepted 2 drones fired at Victoria Base (Baghdad International Airport), then later intercepted a third drone heading for the same installation. A missile landed near a house in Al Qasim district, Babil Province. A drone crashed in village of Hawi Shakhair, Nineveh Province without detonating. Iraqi Kurdistan: drone hit home in Zhian area of Erbil; another intercepted near Erbil International Airport; residents reported explosion near Harir Air Base (hosts US forces).

daily.label: 10 Mar
daily.events: Air defenses intercepted 3 drones targeting Victoria Base at Baghdad International Airport; another fell near a counter-terrorism service facility close to the base; Iraqi media reported an unspecified projectile struck near the base, causing unspecified casualties. Drone intercepted near Balad Air Base (Salah al Din). Drones struck Majnoon oil field in Basra Province. Iraqi Kurdistan: 3 drones intercepted over Erbil, one fell near the Emirati consulate; another drone intercepted near Erbil International Airport.

daily.label: 11 Mar
daily.events: 4 drones intercepted near Baghdad International Airport — no damage. US Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center (near Baghdad Airport): 6 drones launched, 5 intercepted, 1 struck compound. Iraqi Kurdistan: 1 drone fell in Kani Qirzhala neighborhood in Erbil; 2 drones targeting Harir Air Base intercepted; 1 drone targeting Peshmerga 70th Division headquarters in Sulaymaniyah intercepted.

daily.label: 12 Mar
daily.events: Drone targeting US Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center intercepted near Baghdad International Airport. Southern Iraq: 2 foreign oil tankers struck near Basra port and Al Faw area by explosive-laden boats. Iraqi Kurdistan: missile struck Camp Singara in Erbil International Airport complex (Italian forces based there) — no casualties; 2 drone attacks struck joint Peshmerga-French base injuring 6 French soldiers; 1 French soldier killed in attack on facility in Iraqi Kurdistan (Rudaw/LWJ). Drone struck residential home in Koya in a Kurdistan Democratic Party of Iran camp. PMF announced that US forces had conducted 32 airstrikes against PMF headquarters across Anbar, Babylon, Diyala, Kirkuk, Nineveh, Salah al Din, and Wasit since Feb 28. Unclaimed airstrike on Qaim border district, Anbar (PMF's 19th Brigade/Ansar Allah al Awfiya): 99 killed, 43 missing, 123 wounded. Airstrike on Camp Saqr south of Baghdad: 1 PMF member killed, 3 injured. Airstrike on PMF base in Kirkuk: 1–4 PMF fighters killed. By March 12–13, Rudaw estimated ~300 drone and missile attacks had struck Erbil region since Feb 28.
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, PMF statement, Rudaw Media Network

daily.label: 13 Mar
daily.events: 2 drones intercepted targeting US Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center. Drone crashed on farm in Bartella, Nineveh Province. Drone crashed in Abu Ghraib district near Baghdad Airport. Rockets struck K1 Air Base in Kirkuk — no damage reported. Iraqi Kurdistan: drone struck Azadi Camp in Koysinjaq; drone targeting headquarters of Iranian Kurdish group intercepted nearby; drone struck Lanaz oil refinery in Erbil, igniting a fire (no injuries). Unclaimed airstrikes on Asaib Ahl al Haq HQ in Salah al Din and Kataib Hezbollah HQ in Fallujah (Shafaq News). IRI announced 150 million dinar (~$100,000) reward for information on whereabouts of US forces in Iraq.
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, Shafaq News

daily.label: 14 Mar
daily.events: 2 drones intercepted targeting Camp Victory at Baghdad International Airport. US Embassy complex attacked: drone destroyed satellite communications center; separate missile/rocket struck helicopter landing pad. Iraqi Kurdistan: drone struck Lanaz oil refinery again (fire, forced shutdown); drone attacked UAE consulate in Erbil injuring 2 guards and damaging building; 3 drones hit KDP-Iran positions (2 lightly injured); 7 drones targeting Erbil intercepted; drone targeting Sulaymaniyah crashed without injuries; drone targeted Peshmerga base in Dara Shakran. Unclaimed airstrike in Al Arsat area of Baghdad: 4 militia members killed, 8 injured (AFP via Shafaq News). Abu Ali al Askari, Kataib Hezbollah spokesperson and senior commander, killed in strike in Baghdad (AFP security source, Kataib Hezbollah confirmed his death on March 16).
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, AFP, Shafaq News

daily.label: 15 Mar
daily.events: Drone intercepted targeting US Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center near Baghdad Airport. Combined drone and rocket attack struck the same facility, injuring 4 Iraqi security personnel. Iraqi Kurdistan: 2 drones intercepted over Erbil (debris from one hit a house, causing fire and injuring 4 people); 2 drones targeting Sulaymaniyah intercepted; 3 missiles struck Koysinjaq (area hosts Iranian Kurdish opposition camps); 4 drones targeted Komala opposition group positions in Zirgewez — no casualties.

daily.label: 16 Mar
daily.events: 4 separate interceptions of drones targeting the Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center. Rocket targeting US Embassy in Baghdad's Green Zone intercepted. Drone struck Rashid Hotel in Green Zone hitting upper floors — no injuries. 2 drones struck Majnoon oil field in Basra. Drone hit Balad Air Base in Salah al Din. Iraqi Kurdistan: drone targeting US Consulate in Erbil intercepted; 3 drones targeting Erbil International Airport intercepted across two incidents. Iraqi PM Sudani met UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed. Kataib Hezbollah announced death of senior commander Abu Ali al Askari.

daily.label: 17 Mar
daily.events: 2 drones intercepted approaching US Embassy Baghdad; 1 drone not intercepted by defenses and impacted nearby. Unspecified rockets fired toward US Embassy. 1 drone intercepted targeting Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center. Drone crashed near Mosul without exploding. Drone intercepted over Salah al Din near Samarra. Iraqi Kurdistan: 2 drones targeting Koysinjaq intercepted; 8 drones targeting Erbil intercepted; 2 separate missile attacks launched against Peshmerga forces in Balisan.

daily.label: 18 Mar
daily.events: Drone attack struck US Embassy complex in Baghdad, sparking a fire. Drone attack hit Kirkuk Air Base — fire and damage, no casualties. Kataib Hezbollah announced it would pause attacks on US Embassy for 5 days subject to conditions (end Israeli strikes on Beirut, end of attacks on residential areas in Baghdad, CIA withdrawal from federal Iraq). Iraqi Kurdistan: Peshmerga Ministry announced 3 soldiers wounded in drone attacks on two Peshmerga headquarters in Erbil and Sulaymaniyah provinces (Peshmerga Ministry statement). Rudaw: 'Several explosions heard across Erbil as air defense intercepted multiple drones.' French President Macron called for stop to attacks in Iraq.
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, Peshmerga Ministry, Rudaw Media Network

daily.label: 19 Mar
daily.events: Drone crashed near US Embassy complex Baghdad without causing damage. Drone crashed in Al Khalis without casualties. Drone crashed in Al Ibrahimiyah without exploding. 2 drones struck radar system at Umm Qasr naval base in Basra (no casualty details provided). Iraqi Kurdistan: 4 drones targeted headquarters of Iranian-Kurdish opposition military wing in Erbil (fires, damage, injuries); Komala Party headquarters in Surdash targeted — no casualties; Komala facility in Zirgewez attacked — no casualties. Unclaimed airstrikes continued: Baghdad (12th PMF Brigade/Harakat Hezbollah al Nujaba); Salah al Din (6th and 63rd PMF Brigades); Nineveh (30th PMF Brigade strike: 1 killed, 3 injured; PMF Nineveh Operations Command HQ struck). Kataib Hezbollah new spokesperson announced partial ceasefire on US Embassy attacks. Iraqi PM Sudani met NATO Secretary General Rutte, reaffirmed Iraq's commitment to protecting diplomatic missions.
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, Shafaq News, Sudani office statement

daily.label: 20 Mar
daily.events: 2 drones intercepted targeting Baghdad International Airport. Iraqi Kurdistan: drone struck a residential home in Erbil's Talar City causing damage.

daily.label: 21 Mar
daily.events: 3 drones struck Abu Ghraib district, wounding 2 people. Drone hit Iraqi National Intelligence Service (INIS) headquarters in Baghdad, killing 1 officer. Additional attacks targeted Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center and a residential home near Baghdad International Airport. Iraqi Kurdistan: 4 drones targeting Erbil International Airport intercepted; drone fell in Duhok; 3 drones targeted Komala Party headquarters in Sulaymaniyah — no casualties.

daily.label: 22 Mar
daily.events: Drone crashed near US Embassy complex in Baghdad without causing damage. Between 6 and 8 combined rocket and drone attacks targeted Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center at Baghdad International Airport overnight — at least 1 rocket struck the Iraqi Counter-Terrorism Service headquarters, injuring 5 CTS personnel. Iraqi Kurdistan: drone strike targeted Peshmerga base in Makhmur, injuring 3 personnel (Peshmerga Ministry).
daily.source: FDD Long War Journal, Peshmerga Ministry

daily.label: 23 Mar
daily.events: Iraqi Kurdistan: 2 drones intercepted near Erbil International Airport; 4 drones crashed across the region without causing casualties; drones struck KDP-Iran camp near Erbil damaging a medical facility; drone crashed in Khalifan; drone struck residential home in Erbil causing fire; drone fell near Kesnazan. Cross-border: 5 rockets launched from Iraq struck Kharab al Jir military base in northeastern Syria.

cumulative.notes: Iraqi authorities did not publish consolidated cumulative intercept or launch totals. Approximate verified casualties from Iranian/militia attacks on Iraqi soil (Feb 28–Mar 23): at least 1 French soldier killed (Mar 12), 1 Iraqi INIS officer killed (Mar 21), 1 Iraqi soldier killed (Mar 4 Karbala), and dozens of military/security personnel injured. Separately, US/Israeli counter-strikes on Iran-backed militias on Iraqi soil caused substantial PMF casualties (largest single event: 99 killed, 43 missing, 123 wounded in Mar 12 Qaim airstrike). Rudaw estimated ~300 drone/missile attacks struck the Kurdistan Region of Iraq by Mar 13. Erbil also reported ~300 attacks (Rudaw) by that date. Iraq served simultaneously as a target country for Iranian/militia drone attacks on US and diplomatic facilities, and as a staging ground for militia attacks against GCC states.
